pm_tasks.task: Inspect the building envelope, including doors and windows, every year
pm_tasks.reference: Coastal Construction Manual: Principles and Practices of Planning, Siting, Designing, Constructing, and Maintaining Residential Buildings in Coastal Areas (Fourth Edition), Volume II (FEMA P-55)
pm_tasks.checklist: 14.2 Building Elements That Require Frequent Maintenance

pm_tasks.task: Check window glazing for cracked panes, fogging between insulated glass panes, nicks and failed sealant
pm_tasks.reference: Coastal Construction Manual: Principles and Practices of Planning, Siting, Designing, Constructing, and Maintaining Residential Buildings in Coastal Areas (Fourth Edition), Volume II (FEMA P-55)

pm_tasks.task: Check window and door trim for decay, discoloration, open joints and dried-out or separated caulking
pm_tasks.reference: Coastal Construction Manual: Principles and Practices of Planning, Siting, Designing, Constructing, and Maintaining Residential Buildings in Coastal Areas (Fourth Edition), Volume II (FEMA P-55)
